ba.note: Single-column DeepNeo protocol: DeepNeo-CL v4.1 BA head excluded so only the deployed fusion is entered in the ranking. Scores are rounded to 12 decimal places before comparison so that floating-point differences at the ULP level do not spuriously separate mathematically-equal AUROCs (e.g. 0.9935897435897436 vs 0.9935897435897435 in BA week 2021-04-16; 0.6666666666666666 vs 0.6666666666666665 in EL week 2024-05-16). Fractional-rank tie-breaking; non-human alleles already excluded upstream.
